overview: SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 caught Ship 42 with the launch tower for the first time, and Musk followed with a reuse assessment and Starship V4 specs. AI news included Paul Christiano's forecast ahead of tomorrow's Dwarkesh episode, GPT-6 Astra being used for physics research, and longer context windows in Antigravity. The NVIDIA/Jensen Huang departure saga took up much of the investor timeline.

top_items.title: elonmusk - After inspecting Ship 42 post-catch, Musk says it could be reflown after a few weeks of refurbishment
elonmusk - Starship V4 will be ~70m long with >60% more propellant and 9 engines, adding 3 higher-thrust Raptor-Vacuums
dwarkesh_sp - Paul Christiano episode out tomorrow; he puts a 1 in 3 chance on extreme superintelligence within a year
chamath - Argues the US government, not China or AMD, may be the biggest beneficiary of Jensen Huang leaving NVIDIA
gdb - OpenAI's new science blog debuts with physicist Nathaniel Craig using GPT-6 Astra on a lattice Standard Model
demishassabis - Reposts that Antigravity is doubling the context window for its Argon, Carbon and Hydrogen models
elonmusk - Reposts reports that Samsung will invest $1.9B to expand its Austin, Texas chip plant to make Starlink chips
elonmusk - Lufthansa's first Starlink-equipped A350-1000 flies Munich–Tokyo Dec 3; group plans ~850 aircraft by 2029
